meta.source: Reserve Bank of India, DBIE, via the Reserve Bank Innovation Hub's data service
meta.revisionPolicy: Bank-wise figures are the banks' own returns as the RBI publishes them and are not revised once printed; the Outlook's latest March is provisional and is replaced by the next edition's figure. Mergers are disclosed on the acquirer, never joined.
meta.coverage: Infrastructure lending of every scheduled commercial bank, bank by bank, every quarter, on the renumbered list of infrastructure sub-sectors (1 transport to 5 social and commercial), from 2022-06
meta.note: RBI DBIE report 1221 (table 10, "Infrastructure Financing Items"), via the Reserve Bank Innovation Hub's data service, as published from the RBI's off-site returns. Amounts are printed in thousands of rupees (the header says crore; see the adapter) and baked in ₹ crore; ratios in per cent. Operations: domestic (offices in India), overseas (offices abroad), global (both). A series the RBI prints as zero throughout (overseas operations of a bank with none) is left out. Banks are named as the RBI names them; a renamed bank is one series, a merged bank's series ends and the acquirer's carries on, with the merger in its mergerNote. Each bank's group is the group it was last listed in (IDBI Bank moved from the public to the private sector group in 2019).
